name: Metal Solutions, LLC.
old_description: With over 28 years of experience in the welding industry, Metal Solutions LLC provides metal fabrication alternatives for individual home owners, local businesses, local industry and logistic service providers.  Do you need something designed and built from scratch or simply need something repaired or reinforced? Look no further!
about:
Metal Solutions, LLC was founded in 1998 in Billings, Montana. The company operates as a welding and fabrication shop serving customers across the region. Ownership structure and founder names are not disclosed in the available information.

The shop provides MIG and TIG welding, cutting, and fabrication in steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. It also runs a 24‑hour mobile welding service (closed Sundays) for on‑site repairs and construction. Facility size, headcount, and annual production volumes are not published.

Customers range from individual homeowners and local businesses to industrial plants, heavy‑equipment operators, and trucking and trailer fleets. The company lists home and business projects, trucking and trailer work, and industrial plant and heavy‑equipment service as its primary market segments.

The business emphasizes its ability to design and build custom fabrications from scratch as well as repair or reinforce existing structures, with round‑the‑clock mobile response as a key differentiator.
